summary: Camp Jordan: city page, RecDesk facility list + spot detail + calendar, lot map, Esri read. $30-35 confirmed; 56 reservable spots (3-58; stored 58), 30A only, water at 3-8, showers + dump; RecDesk booking 4 days ahead (stored note said 48 h). City policy: 'available only in connection with events held within the park' / 'only on weekends and during special events' -> event-tied availability CRITERIA flag.
flags: CRITERIA (event-tied availability; reviewer decides): the city's policy says 'The RV Campground at Camp Jordan Park is intended for short-term, recreational use and is available only in connection with events held within the park.' and 'RV sites are available only on weekends and during special events.' The RecDesk spots carry 'Reserve' buttons and the calendar feed showed no bookings in Dec 2026 or Apr 2027, but reserving needs a log-in (not attempted), so whether an ordinary weekend with no event can be booked is unverified. Under the fairgrounds rule (ordinary nights outside events) this reads as a drop candidate unless ordinary weekends are open to anyone; the 'weekends' wording suggests they may be.
